title: Scavenger Mob Flag
body:
Syntax: mset <mob vnum> flags Scavenger

Description: Builder mob flag. Each server pulse, a living Scavenger collects takeable loose items lying on the ground in its current room. It never picks up no_take items or enters private apartment storage to clean it. Collected items are held on the live mob (visible in mstat), not saved; they disappear when the mob is removed, killed, or the server reboots. Combine with Wander to clean multiple rooms. Remove the flag with mset <mob vnum> flags -Scavenger.

Date: 2026-09-27
